item.title: Home along the Fly River: An 19-hour journey back to Bosset
item.description: It was around 6 pm on Thursday, 12 February, when we boarded a dinghy bound for Bosset village in the Middle Fly District of Western Province. item.title: PNG Gray listed
item.description: The Financial Action Task Force (FATF) added a pair of nations to a global gray list on Friday, after both failed to fill key gaps in their defense against illicit finance. FATF President Elisa de Anda Madrazo confirmed that at the end of the intergovernmental group's latest summit in Mexico City, FATF has gray-listed Papua New Guinea and Kuwait.
